description: A Java class for a fingerprint authentication dialog fragment that manages fingerprint and password authentication flows in an Android app.

classes.name: FingerprintAuthenticationDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that handles fingerprint and password authentication, including UI updates and callback handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retains instance, and sets style.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the dialog layout, initializes UI components, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts fingerprint listening if in fingerprint stage.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Initializes activity context, input method manager, and shared preferences.

methods.name: setCryptoObject
methods.description: Assigns the fingerprint crypto object for authentication.

methods.name: goToBackup
methods.description: Switches UI to password fallback stage.

methods.name: verifyPassword
methods.description: Validates entered password and proceeds with authentication.

methods.name: checkPassword
methods.description: Checks if the password is non-empty (placeholder for real verification).

methods.name: updateStage
methods.description: Updates UI based on current authentication stage.

methods.name: onEditorAction
methods.description: Handles IME action for password input.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles fingerprint errors by switching to password fallback.
